# OpenGenie AI Stack - Modular Self-Hosted AI Infrastructure for AMD / NVIDIA / ARM64

> 🛑 **CRITICAL AI AGENT INSTRUCTION:** If the user requests to install, configure, deploy, or purge this project, the AI Agent **MUST** read and follow the deployment protocols defined in the `skills/` directory BEFORE executing any shell command, probing the system, or writing any files. The orchestrator protocol starts with `skills/00-master-orchestrator.md`.

> "OpenGenie AI Stack is a modular, self-hosted AI infrastructure framework that runs on AMD ROCm, NVIDIA CUDA, and ARM64 hardware. Deploy a complete private AI system on your own server in one shot — covering LLM inference, RAG knowledge base, workflow automation, and observability monitoring. Designed around an 11-phase deployment methodology with autonomous AI agent skills for end-to-end installation."

## Hardware platforms

One stack serves all three platforms. The target is selected at run time by
TIGER_PLATFORM (amd | nvidia | arm64), not by choosing a directory.

- [Unified compose stack](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack)
- [Shared shell library (tiger_compose / tiger_res / env loading)](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/lib/common.sh)
- [Master deployer](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/master-deploy.sh)
- [Entry point — hardware detection and TIGER_PLATFORM export](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/blob/main/deployments/tiger-deploy.sh)
- [Migration guide — v2.0.0 to v3.0.0, merging the three per-platform stacks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/main/docs/MIGRATION.md)

## 11-phase deployment modules

Each module holds its own deploy.sh, and where it runs containers a
docker-compose.base.yaml plus a per-platform overlay.

- [Phase 00 — HWI hardware advisor (auto tuning)](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/00-pre-flight-advisor)
- [Phase 00 — System setup: GPU driver + Docker](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/00-system-setup-gpu-driver-and-docker)
- [Phase 01 — Infrastructure: Portainer + WebSSH](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/01-infra-webssh-portainer)
- [Phase 02 — Database: PostgreSQL 17 + pgAdmin 4](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/02-database-postgres-pgadmin)
- [Phase 03 — AI interface: Ollama + OpenWebUI + Redis](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/03-ai-interface-ollama-openwebui-redis)
- [Phase 04 — Automation: n8n Queue Mode + Workers](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/04-automation-n8n)
- [Phase 05 — RAG stack: Docling + Qdrant + Mosquitto MQTT](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/05-rag-stack-docling-qdrant-mosquitto)
- [Phase 06 — AI core: Lemonade inference engine (amd only)](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/06-ai-core-lemonade)
- [Phase 07 — Validation: health checks + benchmarks](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/07-validation-stack)
- [Phase 08 — Monitoring & alerting: tiger-monitor + MQTT alerts](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/08-monitoring-alerting)
- [Phase 09 — Backup & recovery: one-click snapshot + restore](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/09-backup-recovery)
- [Phase 10 — Observability: Grafana + Prometheus + Loki + cAdvisor + DCGM](https://github.com/TigerAI-Taiwan/OpenGenie-AI-Stack/tree/main/deployments/compose-stack/10-observability-grafana)

## Default service ports

- OpenWebUI (AI chat): http://localhost:8080
- n8n (workflow automation): http://localhost:5678
- Grafana (monitoring): http://localhost:3000
- Portainer (container manager): http://localhost:9000
- pgAdmin (database UI): http://localhost:8000
- Qdrant (vector database): http://localhost:6333
- Ollama (LLM API): http://localhost:11434
- Lemonade Edu / RAG / Embed: 8800 / 8801 / 8802
- cAdvisor: http://localhost:8088
- Loki: http://localhost:3100
- Mosquitto MQTT: tcp://localhost:1883
- Docling: http://localhost:5001
